note: Optical dispersion library (`materials`) plus an RF/EO/conductor constants library (`library`, referenced from a sim config as `materials.<name>.library: <key>`). Every value carries the source actually read, its locator and condition. Values for which no accessible source could be read are listed under `missing`.
verification: Coefficients compared against the refractiveindex.info database entries (CC0) cited in `source` for each item; n(1550 nm) cross-check is in engine/tests/materials.test.mjs.

formulas.sellmeier_c_squared: n^2 = 1 + sum_i B_i lambda^2 / (lambda^2 - C_i^2), lambda in um; array `C` stores C_i (not squared)
formulas.sellmeier_c: n^2 = 1 + sum_i B_i lambda^2 / (lambda^2 - C_i), lambda in um; array `C` stores C_i (as used)
formulas.table: tabulated n(lambda); evaluated by 3-point Lagrange interpolation

n.citation: I. H. Malitson, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 55, 1205-1208 (1965)
Salzberg and Villa, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 47, 244-246 (1957); fit form by Tatian, Appl. Opt. 23, 4477-4485 (1984)

missing.barium_titanate: Only Wemple-DiDomenico-Camlibel single-term fits (valid 0.4-0.7 um) found; not valid at 1550 nm; BTO thin-film indices depend on growth. Provide n in the sim config with provenance.
missing.lithium_tantalate_sellmeier: No verified Sellmeier fit in hand; tabulated Bond data used instead.
missing.lithium_tantalate_rf_eo: RF permittivity and Pockels coefficients of LiTaO3 not entered. The only accessible table read (Zhu et al. 2021, Table 1) gives eps11,22 = 38.3, eps33 = 46.2 and r13 6.2, r22 0, r33 28.5, r51 8.4 without a clamped/unclamped condition or primary reference. Open-access search 2026-10-15 (DevLog-038): no primary full text readable (paywalled, a repository under maintenance, one anti-bot block); candidate primary sources with verified DOIs are listed in DevLog-038 for download.
missing.lithium_niobate_original_measurements: Weis and Gaylord 1985 read 2026-10-15 (Tables 1 and 4, rendered page images); the original measurements they tabulate ([23] Warner et al. 1967, [45] Turner 1966, [11] Kaminow et al. 1980, [37], [41], [42], [46]) were not read.
missing.lithium_niobate_eo_1550nm: No Pockels coefficient at 1550 nm in Weis and Gaylord Table 4 (clamped rows at 633 and 3390 nm; unclamped at 633, 1150 (r22 only) and 3390 nm (r22 only)); the default is the 633 nm clamped row.
missing.lithium_niobate_rf_eo_composition: Weis and Gaylord do not label the Table 1 / Table 4 samples congruent or stoichiometric (only T_c = 1165 C for Table 1 row [23]); the RF/EO entries of library key lithium_niobate_congruent are therefore not established as congruent-composition values.
missing.rf_loss_tangents: No loss tangent entered; tan_delta_rf stays a per-config sourced input.
missing.thin_film_gold: No thin-film gold conductivity entered; bulk 293 K value only.

library_schema.fields: eps_r (RF relative permittivity, crystal frame: number or {perp, par} with perp = eps11 = eps22, par = eps33), r_pm_per_v (named 3m Pockels coefficients, crystal frame, pm/V), conductor + sigma_Sm (S/m), dispersion (key of `materials` used for the optical index)
library_schema.entry: each field is {value, condition, source_read, locator, primary_cited, verification, verified_on}; verification is `primary` (the original data source or a critically evaluated compilation that checked the original sources was read: Matula 1979, Weis and Gaylord 1985), `secondary_open_access` (an accessible compilation was read; its primary reference was not read) or `secondary_vendor` (a manufacturer data sheet was read)
library_schema.override: config keys override library keys; eps_r {perp, par} and named r_pm_per_v coefficients merge one level deep

lithium_niobate_congruent.description: LiNbO3, trigonal 3m, c = crystal z (axis 3); RF and EO constants from Weis and Gaylord 1985 (evaluated compilation); the key name is kept for config compatibility, the RF/EO rows used do not state the sample composition (see composition_note); the optical dispersion (Zelmon 1997) is congruent
lithium_niobate_congruent.composition_note: Weis and Gaylord 1985, p.197: differences between the Table 1 permittivities 'may be due to stoichiometric differences between samples', the stoichiometry being indicated by the Curie temperature, which is given for row [23] only (T_c = 1165 C); p.199: within the experimental accuracy (+-5 %) the free (unclamped) EO coefficients do not depend on melt composition [28]. No row of Table 1 or Table 4 is labelled congruent or stoichiometric.

eps_r.condition: clamped (constant strain, eps^S/eps0), from capacitance measured at frequencies well above the mechanical resonance (p.197 text: 'Capacitance measurements at frequencies well above the mechanical resonance can be used to determine directly the clamped values of permittivity (eps^S) [23]'); measurement frequency and temperature not given in the source; sample T_c 1165 C
eps_r.source_read: R. S. Weis, T. K. Gaylord, 'Lithium niobate: summary of physical properties and crystal structure', Appl. Phys. A 37, 191-203 (1985), doi:10.1007/BF00614817 (subscription copy, local only: references/_inbox/weis1985.pdf, git-ignored)
eps_r.locator: Table 1 'Relative permittivity coefficients', p.197, row Ref. [23]: eps^T_11 85.2, eps^T_33 28.7, eps^S_11 44.3, eps^S_33 27.9, T_c 1165 C; read from the rendered page image (PyMuPDF, 260 dpi) 2026-10-15
eps_r.primary_cited: [23] A. W. Warner, M. Onoe, G. A. Coquin, J. Acoust. Soc. Am. 42, 1223-1231 (1967), doi:10.1121/1.1910709 (not read)
eps_r.verification_note: Weis and Gaylord is an evaluated compilation that checked values against the original sources (p.198: 'some of the parameter values in [34] were found to be in error after comparison with the original sources'); classed primary as the Matula 1979 gold entry; the original measurement [23] was not read
eps_r.why_this_row: [23] is the row the source names as the direct capacitance measurement of the clamped values (p.197) and the only row with clamped and unclamped values and a Curie temperature for one sample
eps_r.other_rows: same table, eps^S_11 / eps^S_33: [22] Savage 1966 44 / 29; [25] Yamada et al. 1967 43.9 / 23.7; [26] Teague et al. 1975 46.5 / 27.3
eps_r.replaces: Zhu et al., Adv. Opt. Photon. 13, 242 (2021), Table 1 (secondary_open_access): perp 44.0, par 27.9; replaced 2026-10-15 (DevLog-038)

r_pm_per_v.condition: clamped (r^S, constant strain), wavelength 633 nm; p.199: 'A measurement made with a high frequency (rf) electric field corresponds to the clamped condition'; modulation frequency not given; no 1550 nm value in the source (clamped rows at 633 and 3390 nm only). The source rates [11] (r51) and [44] (r22, r13, r33) 'probably the most accurate' (fringing-field corrections, p.199); that set is alternatives.r_pm_per_v_clamped_kaminow1980 and is not applied (DevLog-038). r51 enters only shear (off-diagonal) terms, used by the vector overlap
r_pm_per_v.source_read: R. S. Weis, T. K. Gaylord, 'Lithium niobate: summary of physical properties and crystal structure', Appl. Phys. A 37, 191-203 (1985), doi:10.1007/BF00614817 (subscription copy, local only: references/_inbox/weis1985.pdf, git-ignored)
r_pm_per_v.locator: Table 4 'Linear electro-optic coefficients [x 10^-12 m/V]', p.199, row r^S, 633 nm, Ref. [45]: r51 28, r22 3.4, r13 8.6, r33 30.8; read from the rendered page image (PyMuPDF, 260 dpi) 2026-10-15
r_pm_per_v.primary_cited: [45] E. H. Turner, Appl. Phys. Lett. 8, 303-304 (1966) (not read)
r_pm_per_v.verification_note: evaluated compilation (see eps_r.verification_note); the original measurement [45] was not read; values identical to the previous secondary entry (Veithen et al. 2003, Table I 'Clamped Exp.', citing Rauber 1978)
r_pm_per_v.replaces: Veithen, Gonze, Ghosez, arXiv:cond-mat/0311240v1, Table I (secondary_open_access), same values; provenance replaced 2026-10-15 (DevLog-038)

These more recent values were obtained using refined experimental methods that correct for fringing fields present in previous measurements.'
